California Attorney General Issues Investigative Subpoena to Nvidia

State official opens probe into embattled chip maker to determine whether it misled investors

By

California ’s attorney general issued an investigative subpoena to Nvidia NVDA -3.30 % decrease; down pointing triangle on Thursday, opening a probe into the conduct of the embattled chip maker following the exposure of former chief executive Jensen Huang’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

California Attorney General Rob Bonta said his office is asking the Santa Clara, Calif.-based company whether its powerful chips, or any confidential information, were shared with China. The California Department of Justice is also seeking to determine whether Nvidia NVDA -3.30 % decrease; down pointing triangle misled investors and the public.
